metadata.description: Version-controlled Claude Code skills, packaged as plugins.

plugins.name: interactive-diagrams
plugins.description: Explorable architecture diagrams as self-contained HTML: nested levels, pan and zoom, protocol cards, certificates, view tabs and animated use cases. Three tiered skills: diagram-level-1, -2, -3.

plugins.name: software-factory
plugins.description: A software factory for any repo: feature files in docs/features/ go through intake, spec, build, the repo's own checks, routed reviewers and an approver; each ends as a reviewed pull request you merge.
